text:
Marta: Hey folks, opening my first PR to rework the workspace layout + small migration. Quick q: preferred branch pattern and PR size target? Also pre-commit is failing on black/ruff locally.

Eli: welcome! branch: feat/<you>/short-desc or fix/<you>/... Aim for single logical change, ideally <500 lines. For infra migrations, one migration file per PR.

Marta: so feat/marta/workspace-reorg is ok?

Jun: yep. Add a PR checklist in the body (run pre-commit, smoke test, CI). If it's big, split into refactor + follow-up.

Marta: pre-commit output: black reformatted a file but hook still fails on commit. I ran `pre-commit run --all-files` then tried to commit.

Eli: common gotcha: black modifies files but your index needs updating. Do `pre-commit run --all-files && git add -A` then commit. Or install the pre-commit git hook with `pre-commit install`.

Marta: thanks. Another is ruff import-order error. Root repo has ruff config — should I change pyproject?

Jun: don't override root config. Run `ruff check --fix src/` or `isort` then add. If blocked, open a draft PR and tag a reviewer; we can push style fixes as a follow-up commit.

Marta: who to request for infra reviews? CODEOWNERS lists infra but I want a direct ping.

Eli: ping @jun for runtime infra and add the `@infra` group; CODEOWNERS will also request reviews automatically.

Marta: commit/PR title format?

Jun: use short conventional-ish titles: infra: workspace layout + migration. Add a why and rollback plan in the PR body.

Devex Bot: Reminder: Contributor checklist template applied to draft PR. Add reviewers to trigger auto-assignment.

Marta: perfect, I'll open a draft PR and post the link here once it's up.
